notes.title: Giant profile image monolith (changes when choosing friend's lists)
notes.notes: Added a giant monolith in the sky, to show who is the god of the arena

notes.title: Added collision effects and enemy projectile trails - Various bug fixes
notes.notes:
A Poison trail and explosion is now added to enemy projectile collisions
Rubble now comes off enemies in their colour when hit
Rubble on ground no longer gets enemies stuck (they can now move it around)
Logos now show in full colour, no dithering
Damage inflicted now shows up temporarily within enemy health bar
